# Andrea Saravia Sauter — SARAUTER

> Marketing Director for complex B2B sales — 20+ years building brands, pipeline, and flagship events across LATAM and Europe, now running on AI systems she designed and built herself. Based in Madrid, Spain.

Andrea Saravia Sauter is a Marketing Director with 8 years leading brand development for Ufinet (2014–2022), a digital infrastructure company operating in 17 countries — backed by a written reference from Ufinet's CEO. Since 2022 she has worked as a marketing consultant and project lead for Todofibraoptica, Gold Data, and Avenza Marketing, and currently advises Ufinet on brand positioning. She works in the kind of B2B where the product is technical, the sales cycle runs for months and the buyer is a committee — a pattern that transfers beyond telecom to any complex sale. She holds a Master in Digital Marketing (ESIC Business & Marketing School, Madrid), holds Anthropic certifications in Claude, Claude Code, AI Fluency and Agent Skills, and has designed and built four working marketing tools herself — integrating AI into marketing execution as repeatable systems, not one-off experiments.
